title: Phone status tab mirrors the Mac grid view: the same projects, sessions, what each is doing and its state, live

requirements.text: The phone's status tab shows the same projects and sessions as the Mac app's grid view, each with the same state (working, waiting on TJ, finished) and what it is doing
requirements.check: manual: TJ compares the phone status tab with the Mac grid view and they match

requirements.text: It stays current: a change on the Mac shows on the phone within seconds, with no stale entries
requirements.check: a test changes a session's state and the phone status feed reflects it within a few seconds

evidence: mobile/bridge test/e2e.test.mjs 'the phone gets the Mac grid view live': grid.json rewritten needsYou -> phone got kind:grid with needsYou in <3s; unchanged file pushed nothing in 500ms; dead app pid -> mac:closed, projects []. node --test test/*.test.mjs: 43 pass 0 fail

text: Mac app writes ~/.genlock/phone/grid.json from its own pane state (PhoneGrid.swift, each 0.4s tick, only on change); bridge pushes kind:grid on change; phone Sessions view renders it. Bridge restarted. APK 0.1.455307 shipped by link. Waiting: TJ restarts Genlock (self-build offer) and compares phone vs grid (req 1).
